plain: An official who carries out a duty in an organization.

webster.text: One who holds an office or trust; as a public functionary; secular functionaries.

example.quote: If neither gratitude for the honor of the trust, nor responsibility for the use of it, be sufficient to curb the unruly passions of public functionaries, add new bits to the bridle rather than to take it off altogether.
example.cite: James Madison, Political Reflections, Aurora General Advertiser, Feb. 23, 1799
